notes.title: Update 1.01: Performance Boost, Save Fix, and More!
notes.content:
- Enhanced performance: This update improves the overall smoothness and responsiveness of the game.

- Reduced texture footprint: We've optimized textures to decrease file size without compromising visual quality. This can lead to faster loading times and potentially smoother gameplay, especially on lower-end devices.

- Manual save fix: An issue preventing players from saving their progress manually in the pause menu has been addressed. You can now reliably save your game whenever needed.

notes.title: Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki Livestream Demo Steam Next Fest #1
notes.content:
Immerse yourself in "Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki," a captivating gaming experience that blends Beat em Up, RPG, and life simulation in a vast open world full of possibilities. Explore the bustling streets of Nishinari-ku in Osaka and dive into a ruthless gang war between young delinquents from two rival neighborhoods. Take on the role of Kaito Yamazaki, a young adult from the underprivileged neighborhood of Kamagasaki, and forge your own destiny as you journey through a universe filled with side quests, mini-games, and branching dialogues.

Feel the immersive atmosphere of this game with a real-time dynamic weather system and richly detailed environments. Venture to Tannowa and uncover the secrets hidden within. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings, adding unparalleled depth to this captivating gaming experience.

Don't miss out on "Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki," a thrilling urban adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat through varied gameplay mechanics such as combat, role-playing, exploration, and much more. Get ready to dive into a world where your choices matter and every decision can change the course of your story.

notes.title: Character customization is now implemented
notes.content:
I am thrilled to provide a brief update on the advancements I've made in character customization. While the process proved to be more challenging than I initially anticipated, I'm delighted with the outcome. Kaito, the protagonist, was originally designed as a bald character who constantly sported a backwards cap and sunglasses. However, I have now broadened the range of customization options, enabling you to tailor every aspect to your preferences. With an array of diverse outfits and accessories, you can now personalize Kaito to your liking.

notes.title: Devlog and upcoming demo soon !
notes.content:
Hey there, I've got some exciting updates to share with you all about my game. I'm going to talk about the upcoming demo, some changes to the combat system, and user interface improvements. I'll break it down chapter by chapter, so it's easy to follow.

Chapter 1: Demo Announcement
I'm super excited to let you know that I'll be releasing a demo for my game soon! This will give you a chance to experience the first chapter of my open-world adventure. In the demo, you'll find:

A real-time day and night cycle, limited to one city for now.
Interiors you can explore and interact with.
Fun mini-games to play.
NPCs you can meet and build relationships with.
Random events that bring life to the open world.
My updated combat system with all the new tweaks.
Please keep in mind that the demo won't have all the features of the full game, but it should give you a good taste of what's coming.

Chapter 2: Combat System Enhancements
I've been working hard on improving the combat system to make it more engaging and dynamic. Some of the key updates include:

Better dodge mechanics for smoother combat movement.
Improved AI for more challenging and realistic enemy encounters.
The addition of various combat styles, so you can tailor your fighting approach.

Chapter 3: User Interface Updates
I've also made some significant improvements to the user interface. I want the gameplay experience to be as intuitive and immersive as possible. I'd love to hear your thoughts on the UI once you've tried the demo, so I can keep refining it based on your feedback.

Conclusion:
I hope you're as pumped as I am about the upcoming demo and all the new features I've been working on. Your support and feedback mean the world to me as I continue to develop and improve my game. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to let me know what you think once the demo is out!
